spark_open.description: The creature is shown in right-facing side profile on a plain light background as a single quadrupedal animal that combines mammalian and insect features. It has the overall body shape, dense brown fur, head shape, and clawed paws of a brown bear, but most of its back, neck, sides, and outer limbs are covered by a highly glossy, dark brown to black segmented exoskeleton resembling a beetle. The armor forms overlapping plates along the dorsal midline from neck to tail, with large smooth shoulder and hip shields and smaller plates wrapping the upper and lower legs, while the underside and lower flanks show lighter tan segmented plates with a row of oval openings. Two large, curved, black, serrated horns rise from the top of the head, and a short, pointed, segmented tail extends from the rear. Brown fur remains visible on the head, neck, throat, lower legs, and paws.

meta_spark.description: The creature is a large quadruped shown in side view facing right, with the furry brown head, ears, legs and clawed paws of a bear combined with a glossy dark brown-black segmented exoskeleton covering the back, sides, neck and parts of the legs like a giant pillbug or beetle. The bear head has brown eyes, a black nose and short muzzle, with small rounded furry ears. On top of the head sits a small dark beetle body bearing two large curved notched black horns. The bulky body is supported by four sturdy furry legs ending in bear paws, and the arched back runs from the shoulders to a narrow tapering segmented tail at the rear. The underside and joints show tan flexible segmentation with a row of small oval openings along the side.
